summary: Frontend-only testing of PressableScale micro-interaction component integration. Login page loads without JavaScript bundle errors. App requires Supabase authentication to access authenticated screens (Dashboard, AI, Community, More tabs). Code review confirms PressableScale is correctly implemented and integrated across all 4 target screens.

issues: shadow* style props deprecation warning - Use boxShadow instead (React Native Web compatibility, not related to PressableScale)

critical_code_review_comments: PressableScale component correctly implemented using React Native Animated API with useNativeDriver: true for performance
All PressableScale components have proper data-testid attributes for testing
Component properly handles disabled state - skips animation when disabled
Default scale value of 0.97 provides subtle Apple-like press effect
Animation duration of 120ms is appropriate for micro-interactions
test_credentials: No credentials available - Supabase auth required for authenticated screens
context_for_next_testing_agent: PressableScale micro-interaction component has been integrated into dashboard.tsx (quick actions, signal cards, upgrade banner), ai.tsx (analyze button), community.tsx (FAB), and more.tsx (menu items, logout button). All components have data-testid attributes. App requires Supabase authentication to fully test authenticated screens. Login page renders correctly without JavaScript bundle errors.
